actions: elevates/wrinkles the chin skin, everts the lower lip

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: One of the few facial muscles that both originates and inserts within the same dermal/periosteal region (mandible to chin skin), giving it a short, compact fusiform shape unlike the sheet-like majority of facial muscles.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse, over the mid-chin, along the line from the otobasion inferius to the mid-chin point (the midpoint of the vertical line between the lower labial vermilion border and the gnathion), at the level of a perpendicular line dropped from the medial canthus.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial muscle layer directly overlying the mandibular symphysis; forms the anterior boundary of the 'buccomandibular space', medial to depressor labii inferioris and depressor anguli oris at this level.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Ask the patient to purse/protrude the lower lip (chin dimpling); on ultrasound mentalis is the most medial/anterior muscle layer at this landmark, sitting directly on bone.
structures_at_risk: mental nerve, exiting the mental foramen medial to this point
horizontal labiomental artery (a branch of the facial artery), found deep to depressor anguli oris just lateral to this point
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Derived from a cadaveric (28 hemifaces) and ultrasonographic (12 hemifaces) study of the 'buccomandibular space', a deep connective-tissue plane bounded anteriorly by mentalis -- not a dedicated Sihler/motor-point study of mentalis itself, so no motor_endplate_zones entry is recorded here.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Ji HJ, Lee KL, Iwanaga J, Watanabe K, Kim HM, Kim HJ, Clin Anat 39(4):474-481 (2025), doi:10.1002/ca.70044 (https://doi.org/10.1002/ca.70044) -- retrieved via PubMed
